brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Indonesia continues search for hundreds missing in capsized ship. [1]
Indonesia commits to help achieve Nigeria’s 3m barrels daily oil production target. [2]
SG-based 01Fintech invests in Indonesian digital wallet Dana. [3]
Indonesia got a free aircraft carrier; fixes will cost millions. [4]
01F Group backs Indonesia's DANA in growth equity fintech bet. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR INDONESIA
The investment from SG-based 01Fintech into Indonesian digital wallet Dana signals foreign fintech interest in Indonesia's digital payment sector. [3]
The free aircraft carrier will require millions in fixes, imposing a financial cost on Indonesia. [4]

KEY RISKS
Hundreds remain missing from the capsized ship, posing ongoing search and rescue challenges. [1]

WATCH ITEMS
The search for hundreds missing in the capsized ship continues unresolved. [1]
